methodology: Signals compare the current normalized MTGJSON paper price with the prior local daily snapshot. A flat first observation establishes a baseline rather than fabricating movement.

executiveSummary: 12511 exact-printing price observations were screened for 2026-11-13; 2008 rose and 2274 fell in the latest snapshot.
penny-risers has the strongest latest average movement at +41.1% across 52 cards.
151 signals have fewer than two price sources; treat large percentage changes as a research queue, not confirmed demand.
23 reprint-floor observations require supply and reprint-risk review before buying.
Live catalyst, policy, tournament, EDHREC, completed-sale, and retailer evidence must be reviewed separately before a signal is promoted to Confirmed.

requiredBeforeConfirmed: Official Wizards, Magic.gg, Arena, and Commander Rules Committee policy/product checks

externalResearchQueue.sourceDiversityTarget: At least 10 distinct domains when reasonably available; no single source family above 25% of material claims.
externalResearchQueue.unavailableClaims: No live-web catalyst or completed-sale claim is invented by this deterministic job.

confidenceRules.Confirmed: Printing-specific price movement corroborated by reliable market or liquidity evidence.
confidenceRules.Developing: Real catalyst or deck demand with incomplete broad price/liquidity confirmation.
confidenceRules.Speculative: Spoiler, social, thin-listing, or anticipated-synergy thesis; not confirmed demand.
confidenceRules.Unverified: Useful context exists, but live price, volume, or adoption evidence is not confirmed.

actionGuardrails.buyDiscipline: Prefer targeted singles, portable utility, and verified sealed value over random $50–$60 gift-box purchases.
actionGuardrails.dipRule: Use WAIT_FOR_DIP only when a dip, supply wave, sale volume, or market cooldown is independently visible; otherwise WATCH.
actionGuardrails.doNotChase: Do not promote a thin-listing spike, premium treatment, spoiler premium, or single-source percentage move to a buy call.

disclaimer: This is market research and hobby commentary, not financial advice. Verify condition, printing, fees, shipping, and completed sales before transacting.
